description: High and critical advisories this repository accepts by name. scripts/npm_audit.py fails on every other one, at any count.

advisories.why: No patched release exists (picomatch <= 4.0.7 has no fixed version). It reaches both lockfiles only through build tooling — Docusaurus's globbing and vitest's — which walk this repository's own files, never a remote caller's pattern.
advisories.revisit: drop this entry once picomatch publishes a fix and bump the tree; the gate is what makes that visible.
